name: playwright
title: Playwright (async API)
doc: Playwright-style adapter over xcelerate (Python, snake_case). Methods xcelerate cannot express are emitted as explicit NotImplementedError stubs so the adapter keeps the full Playwright shape.

BrowserContext.doc: Playwright-style browser context (modelled as browser + init scripts).

CDPSession.doc: A CDP session (thin wrapper over the page connection).

Keyboard.doc: Keyboard input (thin wrapper over the page).

Mouse.doc: Mouse input (thin wrapper over the page).

Touchscreen.doc: Touchscreen input (thin wrapper over the page).
